supported_impact: Two demonstrated core defects: internally inconsistent active-user comparison magnitude and false closed-review procedural premise. Patent-law example remains Minor; causal effect remains unidentified.

findings.title: Sixfold active-user comparison conflicts with Figure5
findings.counterevidence: Different windows/filters could explain the discrepancy but are not specified.
findings.impact: The factor-six narrative contradicts the conservative below-2.79 bound in Section 4.3 Community Interests Validation, materially overstating a core empirical comparison of review modes.

repair.statement: Reconcile same-window raw counts and regenerate ratio/figure.
repair.verification: bound verified; exact corrected ratio unverified

findings.core_dependency: Review-mode category -> website active-user comparison -> evidence for stronger engagement under fully open review. The magnitude step is inconsistent even if the displayed ordering survives.

findings.title: Closed visibility incorrectly implies single rebuttal
source_locations: ICML2024 AuthorInstructions Reviewing and Author Response
findings.evidence: Official private process allowed subsequent discussion and multiple responses.
findings.impact: Invalidates a central explanatory premise used to attribute iterative clarification to public disclosure; the paper's own closed ICML category admits repeated private author discussion.

repair.statement: Separate disclosure, discussion rounds/duration and participants by venue/year.

findings.core_dependency: Disclosure category -> purported one-time-only rebuttal in closed review -> interpretation of open-review dialogue advantage. The first implication is false for within-scope ICML2024.
findings.counterevidence: Public commenting may still broaden participation. No equal reply volumes or causal effects across venues are asserted.

findings.title: U.S. patent-disclosure claim omits statutory exception
findings.evidence: 35USC102(b)(1)(A) covers qualifying inventor-originated disclosures <=1 year before effective filing.
findings.impact: Corrects a local absolute premise; general disclosure risk remains.

repair.statement: Include exception and condition risk on jurisdiction, timing, origin and subject matter.
repair.verification: official-source check; no specific application evaluated

findings.core_dependency: A qualified legal example in Alternative Views; it does not support the central empirical engagement comparison or procedural inference. Minor retained.

findings.title: Causal benefits not identified by venue comparisons
findings.evidence: Mode is confounded with venue/content/timing; accepted-only and voluntary samples; unrestricted venue-effects model leaves openness coefficient unidentified.
findings.counterevidence: Position paper uses some tentative wording and acknowledges voluntary bias.
findings.impact: Observed associations remain usable; causal size and direction unresolved.

repair.statement: Retain descriptive claims; additional design/data required for causal claims.
repair.verification: scope repair only, no causal reproduction

findings.core_dependency: The observational comparison lacks identification of the openness effect. This remains Needs Evidence, without claiming that the true effect is null or reversed.
